'''Kyrenic''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who worked with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When the Mandalorian [[Clan Varad]] seized the Republic warship ''[[Allusis]]'', Kyrenic was selected by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] alongside the [[Sith Inquisitor]] [[Vincine]], the [[Sith Warrior]] [[Rotham]], and the Imperial agent [[Andan]] to form a strike team to capture the vessel. However, the team encountered opposition in the form of a Republic strike team, and only one of the two groups survived their conflict.<ref name="Mandalorian Raiders" />
